tools.name: apps_build
tools.description: Build a small app from a description, save it, and return its details and URL. An app is a single page — a tracker, a checklist, a counter — that keeps its own store and runs in the browser

tools.name: apps_create
tools.description: Create an app — a small, self-contained HTML tool hosted here. Takes the HTML; apps_build writes it for you from a description

tools.name: apps_edit
tools.description: Edit an app you own — its name, description, tags, icon, HTML or price. Fields left out keep their value

tools.name: apps_fork
tools.description: Fork an app into your own account, to change independently of the original

tools.name: apps_read
tools.description: Read the details of one app by its slug

tools.name: apps_run
tools.description: Publish a snippet of JavaScript and get back a URL that runs it in a browser. It returns a link rather than output — the code runs in a sandbox when somebody opens it, not here

tools.name: apps_search
tools.description: Search the apps directory for small, useful tools, by name, description or tag

tools.name: apps_test
tools.description: Test an app by checking its HTML and running its mu.api calls server-side, so an author finds out what is broken without opening it

tools.name: blog_create
tools.description: Publish a post to the caller's blog. For anything meant to be read later by other people — notes, write-ups, announcements. For a private note to yourself, prefer files or memory

tools.name: blog_delete
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's own blog posts, by id or title. Refuses posts written by anyone else, and refuses an ambiguous title rather than guessing. Irreversible, so confirm with the user first

tools.name: blog_list
tools.description: Read recent blog posts — titles, snippets and ids

tools.name: blog_read
tools.description: Read one blog post in full, by id or by title. Use after blog_list or index_search has found a candidate and the summary is not enough

tools.name: blog_update
tools.description: Edit one of the caller's own posts. Fields left out keep their current value

tools.name: chat_messages
tools.description: Read the recent conversation in a discussion room

tools.name: chat_rooms
tools.description: List discussion rooms that currently have activity

tools.name: chat_send
tools.description: Say something in a discussion room, as the caller. Use chat_rooms to find the room id

tools.name: contacts_add
tools.description: Save someone to the address book. Adding a name already there updates it rather than making a second card

tools.name: contacts_delete
tools.description: Remove someone from the address book

tools.name: contacts_find
tools.description: Look someone up in the address book by name, part of a name, or address. Use this before sending mail to a person named rather than addressed

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List everyone in the caller's address book

tools.name: docs_create
tools.description: Store a document in one of your collections, or overwrite one you own by passing its id. Private unless you set public

tools.name: docs_delete
tools.description: Delete a document you own, by id

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Read one document by id — yours, or one somebody published

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: List documents in a collection, with an optional filter, sort and limit. Use this to find an id before reading or deleting

tools.name: events_create
tools.description: Schedule a reminder or event at a given time; optionally repeating, and optionally running a prompt through the agent when it fires

tools.name: events_delete
tools.description: Cancel an event by id

tools.name: events_free
tools.description: Find when the caller has nothing booked — open slots of a given length, within working hours

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: List the caller's upcoming events and reminders, each with its id

tools.name: files_delete
tools.description: Delete a file you own

tools.name: files_get
tools.description: Read a stored file back by its id

tools.name: files_list
tools.description: List the caller's stored files, newest first

tools.name: files_put
tools.description: Store a file and get a URL for it — a report, a CSV, a transcript

tools.name: files_share
tools.description: Make a file readable by anyone with its URL, or private again

tools.name: images_generate
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt and return its URL

tools.name: images_search
tools.description: Search the public image library by description and get URLs to reuse. Cheaper than generating: look here first

tools.name: mail_address
tools.description: Get an email address that reaches the caller. Pass a tag for a plus-address (you+tag@) — give that out, then read only its mail with mail_inbox(tag)

tools.name: mail_inbox
tools.description: List the account's most recent messages — read my mail, check my inbox

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Search the account's mail and return matching messages

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Send an email from the caller's own address on this instance. Takes a recipient address, a subject and a body; resolve a name to an address with contacts_find first. The mail really is delivered — there is no draft state to undo from

tools.name: markets_list
tools.description: Get live prices for cryptocurrencies, stocks, futures, commodities and currencies

tools.name: news_list
tools.description: Read recent news headlines with short summaries, balanced across topics

tools.name: news_read
tools.description: Read one news article in full by its id or URL

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Search indexed and live news for a topic

tools.name: notes_add
tools.description: Write a note under a title, so it is there next conversation. Writing a title that exists rewrites that note

tools.name: notes_delete
tools.description: Delete one note by title

tools.name: notes_get
tools.description: Read one note by title. Use it when you know the title; notes_list when you do not

tools.name: notes_list
tools.description: List every note the caller has written, with its text

tools.name: places_eta
tools.description: How long it takes to travel between two places, by road rather than as the crow flies

tools.name: places_geocode
tools.description: Resolve a place name or address to coordinates

tools.name: places_nearby
tools.description: List points of interest near a location

tools.name: places_search
tools.description: Find places by name or category, optionally near a location

tools.name: prayer_qibla
tools.description: Get the qibla — the compass bearing to face for Islamic prayer from a location

tools.name: prayer_reflection
tools.description: Get today's Islamic reflection — a verse of the Quran with its surah, a saying of the Prophet, and a name of Allah

tools.name: prayer_saying
tools.description: Look up a hadith from Sahih al-Bukhari, optionally from a given book

tools.name: prayer_search
tools.description: Search the Quran, the hadith and the names of Allah by meaning — ask a question in plain language rather than naming a reference

tools.name: prayer_times
tools.description: Get today's Islamic prayer times (salah) for a location, and which prayer is next

tools.name: prayer_verse
tools.description: Look up a chapter of the Quran, or one verse within it, by number. Use prayer_search to ask a question instead of naming a reference

tools.name: social_list
tools.description: Read the latest social posts from the network

tools.name: social_search
tools.description: Search public posts on this instance by keyword. This is the instance's own feed, not the wider internet — use web_search for that

tools.name: stream_list
tools.description: Read recent events from the console timeline

tools.name: stream_post
tools.description: Post an entry to the console timeline

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Add a task. Assign it to the agent and it can pick the task up itself

tools.name: tasks_delete
tools.description: Remove a task

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: List the caller's tasks, open ones first; optionally filtered by state

tools.name: tasks_next
tools.description: The next task assigned to the agent — what to work on now

tools.name: tasks_update
tools.description: Change a task: its state, or the result of doing it

tools.name: user_block
tools.description: Block another account, hiding all of their content from the caller's view

tools.name: user_flag
tools.description: Report a post, comment or message for a human moderator to look at. Does not remove anything itself — use user_hide to hide something from your own view

tools.name: user_hide
tools.description: Hide an item so the caller stops seeing it. Affects only this account's view; use user_flag to report something to a moderator instead

tools.name: user_save
tools.description: Save an item to the caller's bookmarks so it can be found again. Private to the caller, and reversible with user_unsave

tools.name: user_saved
tools.description: List the items the caller has saved for later, with their links

tools.name: user_unblock
tools.description: Stop blocking another account, so their posts and messages reach the caller again. Reverses user_block

tools.name: user_unsave
tools.description: Remove an item from the caller's bookmarks. Leaves the item itself untouched — this only forgets that it was saved

tools.name: video_list
tools.description: Read the latest videos from curated channels

tools.name: video_search
tools.description: Search videos from the channels this instance curates. A curated set rather than all of YouTube, so a miss means it is not followed here, not that it does not exist

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Get the weather forecast for a location — current conditions and the days ahead

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a web page by URL and return its cleaned readable content, stripping ads, popups and navigation. Needs an account

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information and news

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "apps_run" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apps_run, blog_create, blog_list, blog_read, chat_messages, chat_rooms, files_put, images_search, mail_address, mail_inbox, mail_search, news_read, social_list, social_search, user_flag, web_fetch · Private data: blog_create, contacts_add, contacts_delete, contacts_find, contacts_list, docs_create, docs_delete, docs_get, docs_list, files_delete, files_get, files_list, files_put, files_share, user_save · Public sink: apps_run, blog_create, blog_read, chat_send, files_share, mail_address, mail_send, stream_post, user_flag · Destructive: apps_run, blog_delete, contacts_delete, docs_create, docs_delete, events_delete, files_delete, notes_delete, tasks_delete, user_flag, user_unsave.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apps_run, blog_create, blog_list, blog_read, chat_messages, chat_rooms, files_put, images_search, mail_address, mail_inbox, mail_search, news_read, social_list, social_search, user_flag, web_fetch · Private data: blog_create, contacts_add, contacts_delete, contacts_find, contacts_list, docs_create, docs_delete, docs_get, docs_list, files_delete, files_get, files_list, files_put, files_share, user_save · Public sink: apps_run, blog_create, blog_read, chat_send, files_share, mail_address, mail_send, stream_post, user_flag · Destructive: apps_run, blog_delete, contacts_delete, docs_create, docs_delete, events_delete, files_delete, notes_delete, tasks_delete, user_flag, user_unsave

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
